name: Y U No
look: A crude rage-comic drawing of a round white head with a furious, contorted face: bulging eyes, a deeply furrowed brow, flared nose and gritted teeth. He throws a hand out with fingers spread in exasperation, set against a flat dark navy blue background.
use: Demands to know why someone or something won't do the obvious thing. The caption follows a broken-English pattern, with the subject on top and "Y U NO" plus the expected action on the bottom.
slots: top caption: who or what is being yelled at
bottom caption: 'Y U NO' plus what it should do
examples: Y U NO print when I'm in a hurry?
Y U NO reach the bed?
describe: angry cartoon face with hand out asking why
rage comic guy throwing his hands up in frustration
furious white drawn head demanding an answer
crude drawing of a man yelling why with gritted teeth
mad meme face on a dark blue background
